name: Hiro Tachi
source: Hiro Tachi needs no introduction. He's just about the biggest Japanese pop star there is! His name has been tossed around even more lately, as his bad boy antics have made headlines. As his new PR Rep, it's your mission to turn it around! Hiro wants to make serious music now, and judging by his lyrics you found, it's definitely the path he should take. Can the two of you convince his manager of this new direction? Or are you letting the old feelings you have for him as your former boyfriend get in the way?
